dependencies.used_for: exact Gamma=Z2 residual-energy identity, beta=ell+c marginals, mixed E3/E2 disjoint-volume density receiver

new_claims.statement: For the complete third-volume packet Gamma containing a fixed physical row pair, with F=||M||F and Z2 the complete E2 mass of that row pair, Z2 >= Gamma/F^2; hence for every fixed-double-pair subpacket H, Z2 >= H/F^2.
Using beta=ell+c and the prior mixed E3/E2 theorem at w=1/10,q=1, ell_*<=2/5 implies a continuous density bound <=52.8322463052 F^(3/7) H^(-5/21).

For a physical E2 packet of mass Z2 and inclusion marginals max alpha<=q/2 with 1<=q<2, the full residual quadratic-plus-affine form R satisfies sup_s E|R-s|^-1/2 <= [8 sqrt(e/2)/(2-q)] q^-1/4 Z2^-1/8.
After exact completion of a nonzero physical scalar pivot a, the Schur cross rows preserve u wedge v wedge w_i and therefore the incident Schur E2 packet Z2^S obeys Z2^S >= Gamma/F^2 >= H/F^2.
If |a|>=sqrt(H)/(2F^2) and the Schur E2 packet has max column marginal<=3/4, then ||p_Q||inf <=23.8366054976 F^(5/4)H^-3/8; essential boundedness only, continuity not claimed.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: Gamma>=H and Z2>=Gamma/F^2 imply ||p_Q||inf<16.488 F^(1/5)H^-1/5 whenever ell_*<=1/4.
